summary: US stocks fell about 2% on Thursday, with the Dow closing below 50,000. Reports blame AI-stock worries, and I saw no trading halts. A report says JPMorgan Chase was hit by a cyberattack on outside service providers. Officials still say the recent outages are not linked.

events.title: US stocks fall sharply Thursday; Dow closes below 50,000
events.impact: Thu: Dow fell 1,101 to 49,097, S&P 500 fell 2.02% to 7,176, Nasdaq fell 2.25% to 23,879. The VIX fear gauge hit about 28 at midday. I saw no trading halts. Tue and Wed were also lower.
events.stated_cause: Reports point to Anthropic's IPO failing to lift AI stocks, Nvidia weakness and rate worries. No technical or attack cause reported.

events.title: JPMorgan reportedly hit by cyberattack on outside service providers
events.impact: An ABC7 live blog headline says Chase reported a cyberattack on third-party service providers. I could not read the details. Earlier, a ransomware gang claimed Visa and JPMorgan; Visa said an Asia Pacific provider was hit.
events.stated_cause: Per the headline, a cyberattack on outside providers. Chase earlier blamed Monday's outage on a software bug. The gang's claim is unverified.

events.title: Equinor still cleaning up after cyberattack on IT systems
events.impact: Equinor says production is not affected and it sees no sign of stolen data. Internal email was reported down. There is no time estimate for full recovery.
events.stated_cause: Equinor calls it a cyberattack, not a virus, so it says it cannot spread. On Nov 18 it said it better understands how it happened. Nobody has named who did it.

sources.name: Reuters via Global Banking and Finance

events.title: NSA classified internal network outage enters third day
events.impact: A senior official said Wednesday that patching is going slower than expected. The NSA campus was limited to essential staff. Officials say core national security work is unaffected.
events.stated_cause: The Director of National Intelligence linked it to urgent patching of PHP software flaws. The NSA first said routine maintenance. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: Officials again say recent outages are unrelated and not malicious
events.impact: On Thursday the administration urged calm and Rubio said he has zero information linking the outages to a bad actor. This is an official view, not a proven finding.
events.stated_cause: Officials point to patching, router work and software bugs. They name no attacker.

events.title: Bitcoin about 62.7K to 64.2K USD, down roughly 14% on the week
events.impact: CoinGecko shows about 63,469 (down 1.8% in 24h, 14.1% in 7 days). CoinMarketCap shows about 64,186. Bitget shows about 62,674. It is a steady slide, not a crash. I found no exchange outage.
events.stated_cause: CoinGecko cites Fed rate-hike fears and fund outflows. No technical or attack cause reported.

events.title: Marriott tech issue reported, then resolved
events.impact: A live-blog headline says Marriott reported a technology problem and later said it was fixed. I found no details on who was affected.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. No cause seen in the data I could read.

events.title: United Airlines system outage briefly affected departures
events.impact: A widespread United system outage on Monday briefly affected departing flights. I saw no sign it is still going.
events.stated_cause: Unknown in the data I saw.

events.title: FAA ground stop; FBI helping review air traffic outage
events.impact: Flights have resumed. The FAA feed at 21:21 UTC shows only weather and volume delays (SFO, LAS, MCO, TEB). The FAA paused new Juniper router installs.
events.stated_cause: The FAA says a new router flooded the network with data. Officials cite routine telecom maintenance. The FBI is helping the FAA, DOT and L3Harris.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: The status page lists degraded performance for Sites and Services, last changed 16:30 UTC today. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare has not given a cause in the data I saw.

events.title: Apple services outage (iCloud, App Store, Apple Music)
events.impact: Apple confirmed sign-in, App Store and Apple Music problems. Some users also reported Apple Pay trouble. Services are back up.
events.stated_cause: Apple says an internal update caused it. It told media it was not a cyberattack.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its list
events.impact: Routine notice covering Synology, LiteLLM, Apache Axis and REDCap software. I saw no new Emergency Directive. The notice does not mention the outages.
events.stated_cause: Attackers are exploiting software flaws. CISA gives no link to the outages.

connection_assessment.reasoning: Equinor confirms a real cyberattack but has named no one. The NSA outage is blamed on patching, Apple on an internal update, and the FAA on a router. Officials say none are linked. One report says Chase was hit through outside providers, which I could not confirm.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.

alert.reason: The new Chase report is unconfirmed and officials still see no link. The stock drop has market-based explanations and no halts.

prep_note: No action is needed beyond normal habits. Keep some cash and a backup way to pay. Watch your bank app for odd activity. If you manage a business, install pending security updates but test them first, since patching has caused some of these outages.
